body:
Yes we may have introduced a "bad" API here. But this is already out and since we did not do any beta-release channel we are kind of stuck, we would have to bump major. (That's another discussion we will have).

What we could do thought is hide the global transformData in our documentation and tell people to use the object one everytime. Because exhaustivity in the API here is important as you discovered.

So I would go for hiding the global option instead of introducing another behavior that would require a breaking change.

We may not have support on this if we do the documentation well.
